APPOINTMENT LETTER
Dear {{ doc.employee_name }},
With reference to your application and the subsequent interviews you had with us, we are pleased to appoint you as “{{ doc.designation }}” with {{ doc.company }} on following terms and conditions,
DATE OF AN APPOINTMENT: {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.date_of_joining, "dd MMMM yyyy") }}
SALARY & ALLOWANCES :
Your Cost to the Company (CTC) is Rs. {{ "{:,.0f}".format(doc.ctc or 0) }}/- ({{ frappe.utils.money_in_words(doc.ctc or 0) }} Only Per Annum).
(Note – All statutory taxes are applicable as per the government norms & it will be deducted from your CTC).
You will be governed at all times by the policies, procedures & rules of the company related to the salary, allowances & benefits. Further, then company, at its sole discretion, may modify or change such allowances, benefits & perquisites from time to time in accordance with its policies.
PLACE FOR POSTING:
This appointment takes effect from your date of joining which is on {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.date_of_joining, "dd MMMM yyyy") }}.
However, during employment with the company, you may be posted/ transferred to any of the offices/ projects/ divisions/ departments/ units of the company or any of the Group companies or to be set up anywhere in India or abroad, without any additional remuneration.
PROBATION / CONFIRMATION :
You will be on probation initially for a period of Six Months w.e.f. the date of joining. If, at the end of the probationary period, you are confirmed in your appointment, you will be communicated of the same in writing. If no such letter of confirmation is issued, the Probationary period shall deemed to have been extended till such time you are confirmed in your appointment in writing.
During probation period, your services are liable for termination at any time without any notice in writing or any payment in lieu thereof by yourself. The company may not assign any reason for such termination which shall be at sole discretion of the Company & you will not be entitled to any claim, damage, compensation or any other payment on that account. During your probation period you will not be entitled for any leaves. You will be eligible for leaves on successfully completion of six months with the company.
LEAVE ENTITLEMENT :
You will be entitled for leaves as per company’s policies which would be calculated on pro rata basis. In case, if an employee is taking pre-planned leaves then employee has to apply leaves on internal on-Line HR system. Any leave will be considered only if it is approved from reporting manager. Any leave without approval of reporting manager will be considered as loss of pay.
COMPENSATION PROGRESSION :
Future increase in your compensation & future prospects in the company shall entirely depend on your efficiency, hard work, and regularity in attendance, sincerity, good conduct & such other relevant factors & the Company’s performance. Such increase in no case shall be automatic and/or a matter of right.
MEDICAL FITNESS :
Your appointment is subject to your declaration of medical fitness to manage the job assigned to you by the company. You are liable to be terminated if any false declaration is made by you during the recruitment process.
DEPUTATION/CHANGE/TRANSFER :
(a)You are liable to be transferred anywhere in India at the sole discretion of the Management depending upon the organizational exigencies. Your services may also be deputed to the Group/Sister Companies as deemed fit by the Management.
(b) Your place of work can be changed at the sole discretion of the Management to any other branch, unit, factory or other site either in existence or which may come into existence. In such event, you will be issued a fresh letter informing you of such change.
(c) You shall not be eligible for any additional / further payment on account of such transfers. Based on your Job Description, may require undertaking business tours and /or other assignments anywhere in India in connection with Company business.
GENERAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBITIES :
(a) The Management will expect you to work with a high standard of initiative, efficiency and economy & encourage & motivate people under you to achieve optimum output.
(b) During your service with the Company, you will not engage yourself directly or indirectly in any other Undertaking, Business, Employment or Activities prejudicial/detrimental to the interest of the Company. Contravention of this will lead to the termination of your service without any notice or any compensation in lieu of such notice.
(c) You shall not give out to anyone, during the period of your service and even afterwards by word of mouth or otherwise, particulars or details of our manufacturing or other processes, technical knowhow, security arrangements, administrative and/or organizational matter of confidential or secret nature, which may be your privilege to know by virtue of your being our employee.
(d) You shall keep confidential all the information and material provide to you by or on behalf of the management or by its clients concerning their affairs to enable the Management to perform the service. This excludes only such material as is already known to the public which also you will not release, use or disclose except with prior written permission of the Management. Your obligation to keep such information confidential shall survive even on termination or cancellation of the employment.
(e) You will be responsible for the safe keeping and return in good condition and order of all the properties of the Company which may be in your use, custody, care or charge. For the loss of any property of the Management in your possession, the Management will have the right to assess on its own basis and recover the damages.
(f) You will not enter into any commitments or dealings on behalf of the Company for which you have no clear authority nor alter or be a party to any alteration of any principle or policy of the Company.
RETIREMENT :
You will automatically retire from the service of the Company on attaining the superannuating age of 58 years. But in case of infirmity or any other valid reason, the management may prepone the retirement age.
TERMINATION OF PERMANENT SERVICE :
(a) The cessation of service can be by either side giving one month notice in writing to the other or in lieu of notice by payment of one month salary.
(b) During your probation period your services can be terminated by giving Seven days’ notice from either side.
(c) The Company reserves the right to terminate your employment at any time without notice in case of misconduct, absence, or policy violations.
(d) False documents will lead to termination.
(e) Absence beyond 7 days treated as abandonment.
(f) Daily reporting required during force majeure.
INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS
You hereby irrevocably assign to {{ doc.company }}, all intellectual property rights developed during employment.
GENERAL:
(a) You will be subjected to the Rules and Regulations of the Company.
(b) You must inform address changes.
(c) Return company belongings during exit.
(d) Disciplinary rules apply.
Area of Jurisdiction: Thane court will have an exclusive jurisdiction.
We look forward to welcoming you.
Thanking You.

Yours faithfully,

For {{ doc.company }}


{{ doc.hr_name or "HR Manager" }}
Human Resources
